positive_snippets:
We had an excellent stay in this hotel and appreciated the Globalist treatment, which was also appropriately extended to my sister with a Guest of Honor.

The hotel is in an odd area, but as we were come to get over jet lag and relax and get orientated, it was perfect. The rooms were clean and well appointed, and housekeeping was excellent. The restaurant was great for breakfast and the chef so kind and generous.

I wasn't sure about what to think about to be grand night without a grand Club but I felt that the alternative was even better. All day soft drinks, including tea, smoothies, shakes, lemonade, hot cocoa (amazing!) in the tea lounge. And in the evening the bar hosts a lovely and high quality buffet and unlimited drinks for 2 hours. Food, service, and atmosphere were all very nice. We were very well cared for by Surbhi and Khushi who made our stay extra special. And Varnit at the bar took excellent care of us.

Hospitality at this hotel is at or above international standards and we would absolutely stay again!

Had a wonderful experience at the hotel. The overall service, cleanliness, and hospitality standards were excellent. The staff was very professional, polite, and always ready to assist. I would especially like to appreciate Ms. Rakhi from Front Office for her courteous and professional approach, Mr. Dikshit and Anuj from Housekeeping for maintaining excellent cleanliness and attention to detail, and Ms. Nisha from the Restaurant for her friendly behavior and great service. Their efforts truly enhanced the overall guest experience. Highly recommended and would love to visit again.
